
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19899326" title="发布于 2026-04-21 10:43">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">开源项目PocoEmit.Mapper重构之扑风捉影</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        借助投影技术极大的增强了PocoEmit.Mapper的映射能力
另外还增加了投影的可扩展性
用户可以根据需要创建自己的投影来实现个性化的映射规则
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一投影技术">一、投影技术</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这里的投影可以实现类似sql投影的效果</li>
<li>也可以类比光线照射在物体上形成的影像</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-投影接口定义">1. 投影接口定义</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>IProjection接口很简单</li>
<li>只有TryConvert一个方法</li>
<li>相同类型对象的转化,返回是否成功以及转化后的结果</li>
<li>约定不符合规则就不转化</li>
<li>一般情况下转化成功的结果会和源对象不同</li>
<li>当然经过多次投影后也可能会和源对象相同了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public interface IProjection&lt;T&gt;
{
    bool TryConvert(T source, out T result);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-三种投影方式">2. 三种投影方式</h3>
<h4 id="21-使用前缀投影来演示">2.1 使用前缀投影来演示</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>前缀投影就是把成员前面加个前缀来映射</li>
<li>sourceMembers模拟对User的反射</li>
<li>通过Projection.Prefix("User")创建一个前缀投影</li>
<li>如果没有User前缀,就增加User</li>
<li>如果有User前缀就不处理</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public record User(int Id, string UserName);
public record UserDTO(int UserId, string UserName);
var sourceMembers = new Dictionary&lt;string, Func&lt;User, object&gt;&gt;()
{
    [nameof(User.Id)] = obj =&gt; obj.Id,
    [nameof(User.UserName)] = obj =&gt; obj.UserName
};
var projection = Projection.Prefix("User");
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-filter投影的case">2.2 Filter投影的Case</h4>
<h5 id="221-csharp代码">2.2.1 csharp代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IDictionary&lt;string, Func&lt;User, object&gt;&gt; result = projection.Filter(sourceMembers);
Assert.Single(result);
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(UserDTO.UserId)));
</code></pre>
<h5 id="222-sql表示">2.2.2 sql表示</h5>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT Id AS UserId FROM User
</code></pre>
<h5 id="223-影像表示">2.2.3 影像表示</h5>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph User
        Id
        UserName
    end
    Id --&gt;|Filter| UserId
</div><h4 id="23-through投影的case">2.3 Through投影的Case</h4>
<h5 id="231-csharp代码">2.3.1 csharp代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IDictionary&lt;string, Func&lt;User, object&gt;&gt; result = projection.Through(sourceMembers);
Assert.Equal(sourceMembers.Count, result.Count);
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(UserDTO.UserId)));
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(UserDTO.UserName)));
</code></pre>
<h5 id="232-sql表示">2.3.2 sql表示</h5>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT Id AS UserId,UserName FROM User
</code></pre>
<h5 id="233-影像表示">2.3.3 影像表示</h5>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph User
        User-Id[Id]
        User-UserName[UserName]
    end
    User-Id --&gt;|Through| UserId
    User-UserName --&gt;|Through| UserName
</div><h4 id="24-cross投影的case">2.4 Cross投影的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>PocoEmit.Mapper重构用的就是Cross投影</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="241-csharp代码">2.4.1 csharp代码</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IDictionary&lt;string, Func&lt;User, object&gt;&gt; result = projection.Cross(sourceMembers);
Assert.Equal(3, result.Count);
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(User.Id)));
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(UserDTO.UserId)));
Assert.True(result.ContainsKey(nameof(UserDTO.UserName)));
</code></pre>
<h5 id="242-sql表示">2.4.2 sql表示</h5>
<pre><code class="language-sql">SELECT Id,UserName,Id AS UserId FROM User
</code></pre>
<h5 id="243-影像表示">2.4.3 影像表示</h5>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph User
        User-Id[Id]
        User-UserName[UserName]
    end
    User-Id --&gt;|Cross| Id
    User-UserName --&gt;|Cross| UserName
    User-Id --&gt;|Cross| UserId
</div><h3 id="3-投影支持横向扩展">3. 投影支持"横向"扩展</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这里说的"横向"就是投影并联</li>
<li>把多个投影组合成多分支的映射规则</li>
<li>通过FirstReturn或ToFirstReturn方法实现</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-横向扩展的case">3.1 "横向"扩展的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 包含User或U前缀就去掉前缀
var user = Projection.RemovePrefix("User");
var u = Projection.RemovePrefix("U");
var projection = Projection.FirstReturn(user, u);

[Theory]
[InlineData("UserId", "Id")]
[InlineData("UId", "Id")]
[InlineData("UUserName", "UserName")]
[InlineData("UserUName", "UName")]
public void TryConvert(string source, string expected)
{
    projection.TryConvert(source, out var result);
    Assert.Equal(expected, result);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-影像表示横向扩展">3.2 影像表示"横向"扩展</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>RemoveUser和RemoveU两个并联的投影</li>
<li>并联投影按照顺序依次尝试</li>
<li>直到有一个投影成功了就返回结果</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph source
        source-UserId[UserId]
        source-UId[UId]
        source-UUserName[UUserName]
        source-UserUName[UserUName]
    end
    subgraph expected
        expected-Id[Id]
        expected-UserName[UserName]
        expected-UName[UName]
    end
    source-UserId --&gt;|RemoveUser| expected-Id
    source-UId --&gt;|RemoveU| expected-Id
    source-UUserName --&gt;|RemoveU| expected-UserName
    source-UserUName --&gt;|RemoveUser| expected-UName
</div><h2 id="二投影在pocoemitmapper中的应用">二、投影在PocoEmit.Mapper中的应用</h2>
<h3 id="1-addprefix">1. AddPrefix</h3>
<h4 id="11-addprefix的case">1.1 AddPrefix的Case</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.ConfigureMap&lt;AutoUserDTO, User&gt;()
    .Source
    .AddPrefix("User");
var source = new AutoUserDTO { UserId = "222", UserName = "Jxj2" };
var converter = mapper.GetConverter&lt;AutoUserDTO, User&gt;();
var result = converter.Convert(source);
Assert.NotNull(result);
Assert.Equal(source.UserId, result.Id.ToString());
Assert.Equal(source.UserName, result.UserName);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-addprefix使用的是去除前缀投影removeprefix">1.2 AddPrefix使用的是去除前缀投影(RemovePrefix)</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AddPrefix("User")会调用Projection.RemovePrefix("User")来创建一个去除前缀投影</li>
<li>AutoUserDTO两个成员分别是UserId和UserName</li>
<li>User两个成员分别是Id和UserName</li>
<li>对AutoUserDTO投影的效果相当于sql: SELECT UserId,UserName,UserId AS Id FROM AutoUserDTO</li>
<li>通过这个投影,两边的成员名就能完美匹配上了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="13-影像演示一下这个过程">1.3 影像演示一下这个过程</h4>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph AutoUserDTO
        source-UserId[UserId]
        source-UserName[UserName]
    end

    subgraph AutoUserDTO投影
        projection-UserId[UserId]
        projection-UserName[UserName]
        projection-Id[Id]
        projection-Name[Name]
    end

    subgraph User
        result-Id[Id]
        result-UserName[UserName]
    end

    source-UserId --&gt;|RemoveUser| projection-Id
    source-UserName --&gt;|RemoveUser| projection-Name
    source-UserId --&gt;| | projection-UserId
    source-UserName --&gt;| | projection-UserName

    result-Id --&gt;| Mapping | projection-Id
    result-UserName --&gt;| Mapping | projection-UserName
</div><h4 id="14-使用前缀投影prefix也可以实现类似的效果">1.4 使用前缀投影(Prefix)也可以实现类似的效果</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过Projection.Prefix("User")创建一个前缀投影</li>
<li>这时就需要对User进行投影</li>
<li>对User投影的效果相当于sql: SELECT Id,UserName,Id AS UserId FROM User</li>
<li>PocoEmit.Mapper使用RemovePrefix是为了投影的成员名更短,更容易匹配上</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="141-影像演示一下这个过程">1.4.1 影像演示一下这个过程</h5>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph AutoUserDTO
        source-UserId[UserId]
        source-UserName[UserName]
    end

    subgraph User
        result-Id[Id]
        result-UserName[UserName]
    end
    subgraph User投影
        projection-Id[Id]
        projection-UserName[UserName]
        projection-UserId[UserId]
    end
    result-Id --&gt;| | projection-Id
    result-UserName --&gt;| | projection-UserName
    result-Id --&gt;|AddUser| projection-UserId    

    projection-UserId --&gt;|Mapping| source-UserId
    projection-UserName --&gt;|Mapping| source-UserName
</div><h3 id="2-addprefix替换前缀重载">2. AddPrefix替换前缀重载</h3>
<h4 id="21-addprefix替换前缀重载的case">2.1 AddPrefix替换前缀重载的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AddPrefix("User", "U")会调用Projection.ReplacePrefix("User", "U")</li>
<li>创建了一个替换前缀投影</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.ConfigureMap&lt;AutoUserDTO, UserCustomDTO&gt;()
    .Source
    .AddPrefix("User", "U");
var source = new AutoUserDTO { UserId = "555", UserName = "Jxj5" };
var converter = mapper.GetConverter&lt;AutoUserDTO, UserCustomDTO&gt;();
var result = converter.Convert(source);
Assert.NotNull(result);
Assert.Equal(source.UserId, result.UId.ToString());
Assert.Equal(source.UserName, result.UName);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-影像演示一下这个过程">2.2 影像演示一下这个过程</h4>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph AutoUserDTO
        source-UserId[UserId]
        source-UserName[UserName]
    end
    subgraph AutoUserDTO投影
        projection-UserId[UserId]
        projection-UserName[UserName]
        projection-UId[UId]
        projection-UName[UName]
    end
    subgraph UserCustomDTO
        result-UId[UId]
        result-UName[UName]
    end

    source-UserId --&gt;| | projection-UserId
    source-UserName --&gt;| | projection-UserName
    source-UserId --&gt;|UserToU| projection-UId
    source-UserName --&gt;|UserToU| projection-UName

    result-UId --&gt; |Mapping| projection-UId
    result-UName --&gt; |Mapping| projection-UName
</div><h4 id="23-对usercustomdto替换的case">2.3 对UserCustomDTO替换的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>对UserCustomDTO投影的效果相当于sql: SELECT UId,UName,UId AS UserId,UName AS UserName FROM UserCustomDTO</li>
<li>通过这个投影,两边的成员名也能完美匹配上了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.ConfigureMap&lt;AutoUserDTO, UserCustomDTO&gt;()
    .Dest
    .AddPrefix("U", "User");
var source = new AutoUserDTO { UserId = "555", UserName = "Jxj5" };
var converter = mapper.GetConverter&lt;AutoUserDTO, UserCustomDTO&gt;();
var result = converter.Convert(source);
Assert.NotNull(result);
Assert.Equal(source.UserId, result.UId.ToString());
Assert.Equal(source.UserName, result.UName);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="24-usercustomdto替换的影像">2.4 UserCustomDTO替换的影像</h4>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph AutoUserDTO
        source-UserId[UserId]
        source-UserName[UserName]
    end
    subgraph UserCustomDTO
        result-UId[UId]
        result-UName[UName]
    end
    subgraph UserCustomDTO投影
        projection-UserId[UserId]
        projection-UserName[UserName]
        projection-UId[UId]
        projection-UName[UName]
    end

    result-UId --&gt;| | projection-UId
    result-UName --&gt;| | projection-UName
    result-UId --&gt;| UToUser | projection-UserId
    result-UName --&gt;| UToUser | projection-UserName


    projection-UserId --&gt;|Mapping| source-UserId
    projection-UserName --&gt;|Mapping| source-UserName
</div><h3 id="3-addsuffix">3. AddSuffix</h3>
<h4 id="31-addsuffix替换后缀的case">3.1 AddSuffix替换后缀的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AddSuffix("y", "ies")会调用Projection.ReplaceSuffix("y", "ies")</li>
<li>创建一个替换后缀投影</li>
<li>常用于单复数拼写转化</li>
<li>对Customer投影的效果相当于sql: SELECT Name,City,Name AS CustomerName,City AS CustomerCities FROM Customer</li>
<li>ConfigureMap方法默认会把源类名作为目标的前缀,也把目标类名作为源的前缀,</li>
<li>所以在这个例子里没有显示调用AddPrefix,Customer前缀自动生效了</li>
<li>如果不需要默认规则可以通过参数autoRecognize设置为false禁用掉</li>
<li>AddSuffix也支持去掉后缀的重载与AddPrefix类似,用法简单,这里就不展示了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.ConfigureMap&lt;Customer, CustomerDTO&gt;()
    .Source
    .AddSuffix("y", "ies");
var source = new Customer("Jxj", "北京");
var converter = mapper.GetConverter&lt;Customer, CustomerDTO&gt;();
var result = converter.Convert(source);
Assert.NotNull(result);
Assert.Equal(source.Name, result.CustomerName);
Assert.Equal(source.City, result.CustomerCities);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-addsuffix替换后缀的影像">3.2 AddSuffix替换后缀的影像</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>上面文字描述的内容比较抽象</li>
<li>大家看以下影像就清楚了</li>
<li>借助强大的投影能力</li>
<li>Mapping就很简单了,直接同名映射(一般忽略大小写,是否忽略大小写可以配置)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph Customer
        source-Name[Name]
        source-City[City]
    end
    subgraph Customer投影
        projection-Name[Name]
        projection-City[City]
        projection-Cities[Cities]
    end
    subgraph CustomerDTO投影
        projection2-CustomerName[CustomerName]
        projection2-CustomerCities[CustomerCities]
        projection2-Name[Name]
        projection2-Cities[Cities]
    end
    subgraph CustomerDTO
        result-CustomerName[CustomerName]
        result-CustomerCities[CustomerCities]
    end

    source-Name --&gt;| | projection-Name
    source-City --&gt;| | projection-City
    source-City --&gt;|yToies| projection-Cities

    result-CustomerName --&gt;| | projection2-CustomerName
    result-CustomerCities --&gt;| | projection2-CustomerCities
    result-CustomerName --&gt;| RemoveCustomer | projection2-Name
    result-CustomerCities --&gt;|RemoveCustomer| projection2-Cities

    projection2-Name --&gt;|Mapping| projection-Name
    projection2-Cities --&gt;|Mapping| projection-Cities
</div><h3 id="4-addprojection">4. AddProjection</h3>
<h4 id="41-addprojection的case">4.1 AddProjection的Case</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Projection.Replace("Nume", "Name")创建替换"Nume"为"Name"的投影</li>
<li>通过AddProjection引用投影,来实现更个性化的映射规则</li>
<li>实现了可扩展的映射规则,不仅限于前缀或后缀的规则</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.ConfigureMap&lt;ProductJson, Product&gt;()
    .Source
    .AddProjection(Projection.Replace("Nume", "Name"));
var source = new ProductJson { CityNume = "北京", ProductNumeCount = 999 };
var converter = mapper.GetConverter&lt;ProductJson, Product&gt;();
var result = converter.Convert(source);
Assert.NotNull(result);
Assert.Equal(source.CityNume, result.CityName);
Assert.Equal(source.ProductNumeCount, result.ProductNameCount);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-addprojection的影像">4.2 AddProjection的影像</h4>
<div class="mermaid">graph LR
    subgraph ProductJson
        source-CityNume[CityNume]
        source-ProductNumeCount[ProductNumeCount]
    end
    subgraph ProductJson投影
        projection-CityNume[CityNume]
        projection-ProductNumeCount[ProductNumeCount]
        projection-CityName[CityName]
        projection-ProductNameCount[ProductNameCount]
    end
    subgraph Product
        result-CityName[CityName]
        result-ProductNameCount[ProductNameCount]
    end

    source-CityNume --&gt;| | projection-CityNume
    source-ProductNumeCount --&gt;| | projection-ProductNumeCount
    source-CityNume --&gt;|NumeToName| projection-CityName
    source-ProductNumeCount --&gt;|NumeToName| projection-ProductNameCount

    result-CityName --&gt;|Mapping| projection-CityName
    result-ProductNameCount --&gt;|Mapping| projection-ProductNameCount
</div><h2 id="三总结">三、总结</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>借助投影技术极大的增强了PocoEmit.Mapper的映射能力</li>
<li>另外还增加了PocoEmit.Mapper映射的可扩展性</li>
<li>用户可以根据需要创建自己的投影来实现个性化的映射规则</li>
<li>Mapper只是投影的一个应用场景,笔者还在开发投影在SourceGenerator的应用</li>
<li>投影项目hand.projections就是把类似代码抽象成一个独立的库</li>
<li>每个投影功能很简单,不同场景下复用并组合来实现复杂需求才是投影的魅力所在</li>
<li>更多PocoEmit.Mapper可以查看本合集其他文章</li>
<li>dotnet add package PocoEmit.Mapper --version 0.8.8.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>投影库的源码地址:<br>
github: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Projections" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Projections</a><br>
